mapper.insert: INSERT INTO generated_drafts (site_id, keyword, title, slug, excerpt, content_html, tags, categories, wordpress_category_id, verification_score, approved, issues, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, official_images, status) VALUES (#{siteId}, #{keyword}, #{title}, #{slug}, #{excerpt}, #{contentHtml}, #{tags}, #{categories}, #{wordpressCategoryId}, #{verificationScore}, #{approved}, #{issues}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{officialImages}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT d.*, s.name AS site_name FROM generated_drafts d JOIN wordpress_sites s ON s.id = d.site_id WHERE d.site_id = #{value} ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC, d.id DESC
